problem: WC_Tax scalar helper methods issue repeated single-rate queries when callers pass a tax rate ID instead of a hydrated rate object.

benchmark_shape.fixture: One inserted tax rate: US/CA, 7.2500, name PERF, priority 1, non-compound.
benchmark_shape.loop: 1,000 iterations; each iteration calls WC_Tax::get_rate_code(), WC_Tax::get_rate_label(), WC_Tax::is_compound(), and WC_Tax::get_rate_percent_value() with the same scalar tax_rate_id.
benchmark_shape.query_counter: SAVEQUERIES wpdb query log filtered for woocommerce_tax_rates

baseline.interpretation: Each scalar helper performs its own tax-rate SQL query. The extra total queries are cleanup deletes after the loop.

candidate_pr_30.interpretation: The helper loop performs one tax-rate row query, then reuses request-local cached row data. The extra total queries are cleanup deletes after the loop.

cache_invalidation.shape: Insert tax rate named OLD, read/cache label, update rate name to NEW through WC_Tax::_update_tax_rate(), read label again.

object_mutation.shape: Fetch _get_tax_rate( ..., OBJECT ), mutate the returned object's tax_rate_name, then read label through WC_Tax::get_rate_label().
object_mutation.interpretation: The cache stores raw row data and returns fresh objects, so caller mutation of an object return does not poison the cached row.
